units.zh: 孝獻皇帝諱協，靈帝中子也。
units.en: Emperor Xiao Xian's personal name was Xie; he was the middle son of Emperor Ling.
units.literal: Emperor Xiao Xian's personal name was Xie; he was the middle son of Emperor Ling.

units.zh: 母王美人，為何皇后所害。
units.en: His mother, Beauty Wang, was killed by Empress He.
units.literal: His mother, Beauty Wang, was killed by Empress He.

units.zh: 中平六年四月，少帝即位，封帝為勃海王，徙封陳留王。
units.en: In the fourth month of Zhongping 6, when the Young Emperor came to the throne, Xie was enfeoffed as King of Bohai and then transferred as King of Chenliu.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Zhongping 6, when the Young Emperor ascended the throne, the emperor was enfeoffed as King of Bohai and then transferred in enfeoffment to King of Chenliu.

units.zh: 九月甲戌，即皇帝位，年九歲。
units.en: On jiaxu in the ninth month the boy emperor took the throne; he was nine years old.
units.literal: On jiaxu of the ninth month, he assumed the imperial seat, aged nine.

units.zh: 遷皇太后於永安宮。
units.en: The empress dowager was relocated to Yongan Palace.
units.literal: He moved the empress dowager to Yongan Palace.

units.zh: 大赦天下。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
units.literal: He issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 改昭寧為永漢。
units.en: The era name was changed from Zhaoning to Yonghan.
units.literal: He changed Zhaoning to Yonghan.

units.zh: 丙子，董卓殺皇太后何氏。
units.en: On bingzi Dong Zhuo had Empress Dowager He murdered.
units.literal: On bingzi, Dong Zhuo killed Empress Dowager née He.

units.zh: 初令侍中、給事黃門侍郎員各六人。
units.en: The court first fixed the establishment at six palace attendants and six gentlemen consultants at the yellow gates.
units.literal: For the first time he fixed the palace attendants and the gentlemen consultants at the Yellow Gates at six men each.

units.zh: 賜公卿以下至黃門侍郎家一人為郎，以補宦官所領諸署，侍於殿上。
units.en: One son from each household from the highest ministers down to the gentlemen consultants at the yellow gates was appointed gentleman to staff the bureaus the eunuchs had controlled, serving in the palace halls.
units.literal: He bestowed on the households of the ministers of state down to the gentlemen consultants at the Yellow Gates one man each as gentleman, to fill the various offices the eunuchs had led, serving in the hall.

units.zh: 乙酉，以太尉劉虞為大司馬。
units.en: On yiyou Liu Yu, grand commandant, was appointed grand marshal.
units.literal: On yiyou, Grand Commandant Liu Yu was made grand marshal.

units.zh: 董卓自為太尉，加鈇鉞、虎賁。
units.en: Dong Zhuo took the grand commandant’s post for himself, with the ceremonial axe and halberd and a tiger-lancer guard.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo personally became Grand Commandant, with added axe and halberd insignia and tiger lancers.

units.zh: 丙戌，太中大夫楊彪為司空。
units.en: On bingxu Yang Biao, grand counselor, became minister of works.
units.literal: On bingxu, Grand Counselor Yang Biao was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 甲午，豫州牧黃琬為司徒。
units.en: On jiawu Huang Wan, shepherd of Yu province, was appointed minister of education.
units.literal: On jiawu, Shepherd of Yu Huang Wan was made Minister of Education.

units.zh: 遣使弔祠故太傅陳蕃、大將軍竇武等。
units.en: Envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice at the shrines of Chen Fan, Dou Wu, and the other victims of the earlier purge.
units.literal: He sent envoys to offer condolences and sacrifice to former Grand Tutor Chen Fan, General-in-Chief Dou Wu, and others.

units.zh: 冬十月乙巳，葬靈思皇后。
units.en: On yisi in the tenth month Empress Dowager He, posthumously titled Lingsi, was interred.
units.literal: On yisi of winter, the tenth month, Empress Dowager Lingsi was buried.

units.zh: 白波賊寇河東，董卓遣其將牛輔擊之。
units.en: The White Wave raiders struck Hedong; Dong Zhuo dispatched Niu Fu against them.
units.literal: The White Wave bandits raided Hedong; Dong Zhuo sent his general Niu Fu to strike them.

units.zh: 十一月癸酉，董卓為相國。
units.en: On guiyou in the eleventh month Dong Zhuo was made minister of state.
units.literal: On guiyou of the eleventh month, Dong Zhuo became minister of state.

units.zh: 十二月戊戌，司徒黃琬為太尉，司空楊彪為司徒，光祿勳荀爽為司空。
units.en: On wuxu Huang Wan became grand commandant, Yang Biao moved to minister of education, and Xun Shuang took the ministry of works.
units.literal: On wuxu of the twelfth month, Minister of Education Huang Wan was made Grand Commandant, Minister of Works Yang Biao was made Minister of Education, and Superintendent of the Household for Imperial Proceedings Xun Shuang was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 省扶風都尉，置漢安都護。
units.en: The Fufeng commandant was abolished in favor of a Han’an protector.
units.literal: He abolished the Fufeng commandant and established the Han’an protector.

units.zh: 詔除光熹、昭寧、永漢三號，還復中平六年。
units.en: An edict abolished the three short-lived era names and reverted the calendar to the sixth year of Zhongping.
units.literal: He ordered removal of the three reign titles Guangxi, Zhaoning, and Yonghan, restoring the sixth year of Zhongping.

units.zh: 初平元年春正月，山東州郡起兵以討董卓。
units.en: In the first month of the first Chuping year commanderies east of the Taihang rose in arms against Dong Zhuo.
units.literal: In the first year of Chuping, spring, first month, the eastern provinces east of the mountains raised troops to campaign against Dong Zhuo.

units.zh: 辛亥，大赦天下。
units.en: On xinhai a general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: On xinhai, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 癸酉，董卓殺弘農王。
units.en: On guiyou Dong Zhuo murdered the deposed emperor, the prince of Hongnong.
units.literal: On guiyou, Dong Zhuo killed the king of Hongnong.

units.zh: 白波賊寇東郡。
units.en: White Wave raiders pillaged Dong commandery.
units.literal: The White Wave bandits raided Dong commandery.

units.zh: 二月乙亥，太尉黃琬、司徒楊彪免。
units.en: On yihai in the second month Huang Wan and Yang Biao were removed as grand commandant and minister of education.
units.literal: On yihai of the second month, Grand Commandant Huang Wan and Minister of Education Yang Biao were dismissed.

units.zh: 庚辰，董卓殺城門校尉伍瓊、督軍校尉周珌。
units.en: On gengchen Dong Zhuo executed Wu Qiong, commandant of the gates, and Zhou Bi, colonel director of the army.
units.literal: On gengchen, Dong Zhuo killed Commandant of the Gates Wu Qiong and Colonel Director of the Army Zhou Bi.

units.zh: 以光祿勳趙謙為太尉，太僕王允為司徒。
units.en: Zhao Qian, superintendent of the household for imperial proceedings, became grand commandant; Wang Yun, grand coachman, became minister of education.
units.literal: Superintendent of the Household for Imperial Proceedings Zhao Qian was made Grand Commandant, and Grand Coachman Wang Yun was made Minister of Education.

units.zh: 丁亥，遷都長安。
units.en: On dinghai the court ordered the capital transferred to Chang’an.
units.literal: On dinghai, he moved the capital to Chang’an.

units.zh: 董卓驅徙京師百姓悉西入關，自留屯畢圭苑。
units.en: Dong Zhuo herded the entire population of Luoyang west through the passes while he stayed behind encamped at Bigui Park.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo drove and moved the common people of the capital all west through the passes, himself remaining encamped at Bigui Park.

units.zh: 壬辰，白虹貫日。
units.en: On renchen a white rainbow spanned the sun.
units.literal: On renchen, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 三月乙巳，車駕入長安，幸未央宮。
units.en: On yisi the imperial train reached Chang’an and the court took up residence in Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: On yisi of the third month, the imperial carriage entered Chang’an and visited Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 己酉，董卓焚洛陽宮廟及人家。
units.en: On jiyou Dong Zhuo torched the Luoyang palace complex, ancestral shrines, and countless homes.
units.literal: On jiyou, Dong Zhuo burned the Luoyang palaces, shrines, and commoners’ houses.

units.zh: 戊午，董卓殺太傅袁隗、太僕袁基，夷其族。
units.en: On wuwu Dong Zhuo slaughtered Yuan Kui, the grand tutor, and Yuan Ji, the grand coachman, and wiped out their kin.
units.literal: On wuwu, Dong Zhuo killed Grand Tutor Yuan Kui and Grand Coachman Yuan Ji and exterminated their clans.

units.zh: 夏五月，司空荀爽薨。
units.en: Xun Shuang, minister of works, died in the fifth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Minister of Works Xun Shuang died.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，光祿大夫种拂為司空。
units.en: On xinchou Chong Fu, grandee of brilliant candidacy, was appointed minister of works.
units.literal: On xinchou of the sixth month, Grandee of Brilliant Candidacy Chong Fu was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 大鴻臚韓融、少府陰脩、執金吾胡母班、將作大匠吳脩、越騎校尉王瓌安集關東，後將軍袁術、河內太守王匡各執而殺之，唯韓融獲免。
units.en: Han Rong, Yin Xiu, Humu Ban, Wu Xiu, and Wang Gui were sent east to conciliate the warlords; Yuan Shu and Wang Kuang seized and executed them all except Han Rong.
units.literal: Grand Herald Han Rong, Junior Prefect Yin Xiu, Bearer of the Golden Mace Humu Ban, Court Architect Wu Xiu, and Colonel of the Agile Cavalry Wang Gui pacified the east of the passes; General of the Rear Yuan Shu and Administrator of Henei Wang Kuang each seized and killed them; only Han Rong was spared.

units.zh: 董卓壞五銖錢，更鑄小錢。
units.en: Dong Zhuo demonetized the five-zhu coin and issued debased small change.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo destroyed the five-zhu cash and recast small coins.

units.zh: 光武中興，除王莽貨泉，更用五銖錢。
units.en: After Guangwu restored the Han, he abolished Wang Mang’s huoquan coins and again used five-zhu coins.
units.literal: After Guangwu restored the Han, he abolished Wang Mang’s huoquan coins and again used five-zhu coins.

units.zh: 冬十一月庚戌，鎮星、熒惑、太白合於尾。
units.en: On gengxu in the eleventh month Saturn, Mars, and Venus met in the Tail constellation.
units.literal: On gengxu of winter, the eleventh month, Saturn, Mars, and Venus converged in the Tail asterism.

units.zh: 是歲，有司奏，和、安、順、桓四帝無功德，不宜稱宗，又恭懷、敬隱、恭愍三皇后並非正嫡，不合稱后，皆請除尊號。
units.en: Officials argued that Emperors He, An, Shun, and Huan did not merit the temple epithet “founding ancestor,” and that Empresses Liang, Wang, and Fu had never been chief consorts, so their posthumous empress titles should be stripped.
units.literal: That year, the responsible officials memorialized that the four emperors He, An, Shun, and Huan lacked merit and virtue and ought not to be called “zong,” and further that the three empresses Gonghuai, Jingyin, and Gongmin were not proper chief consorts and ought not to be called “hou,” all requesting removal of their honored titles.

units.zh: 制曰：『可。』
units.en: The edict answered, “It may be done.”.
units.literal: The decree said, “It is permitted.”.

units.zh: 孫堅殺荊州刺史王叡，又殺南陽太守張咨。
units.en: Sun Jian then killed Wang Rui, the inspector of Jing, and Zhang Zi, the governor of Nanyang.
units.literal: Sun Jian killed Inspector of Jing Wang Rui, and also killed Nanyang Governor Zhang Zi.

units.zh: 二年春正月辛丑，大赦天下。
units.en: On xinchou in the first month of the second year a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month xinchou, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 二月丁丑，董卓自為太師。
units.en: On dingchou in the second month Dong Zhuo took the title of grand preceptor.
units.literal: On dingchou of the second month, Dong Zhuo personally became grand preceptor.

units.zh: 袁術遣將孫堅與董卓將胡軫戰於陽人，軫軍大敗。
units.en: The general Sun Jian, sent by Yuan Shu, clashed with Hu Zhen at Yangren and shattered Dong Zhuo’s army.
units.literal: Yuan Shu sent his general Sun Jian to fight Dong Zhuo’s general Hu Zhen at Yangren; Zhen’s army was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 董卓遂發掘洛陽諸帝陵。
units.en: Dong Zhuo then had the Han imperial tombs around Luoyang opened and plundered.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo thereupon excavated the imperial tombs at Luoyang.

units.zh: 夏四月，董卓入長安。
units.en: Dong Zhuo arrived in Chang’an in the fourth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Dong Zhuo entered Chang’an.

units.zh: 六月丙戌，地震。
units.en: The earth shook on bingxu in the sixth month.
units.literal: On bingxu of the sixth month, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 秋七月，司空种拂免，光祿大夫濟南淳于嘉為司空。
units.en: In the seventh month Chong Fu left the ministry of works; Chunyu Jia of Jinan, grandee of brilliant candidacy, replaced him.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Minister of Works Chong Fu was dismissed, and Grandee of Brilliant Candidacy Chunyu Jia of Jinan was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 太尉趙謙罷，太常馬日磾為太尉。
units.en: Zhao Qian was dismissed as grand commandant; Ma Midi, minister of ceremonies, succeeded him.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Zhao Qian was removed, and Minister of Ceremonies Ma Midi was made Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 九月，蚩尤旗見于角、亢。
units.en: In the ninth month a cometlike “Chiyou banner” appeared in the Horn and Neck asterisms.
units.literal: In the ninth month, the Chiyou banner appeared in Horn and Neck.

units.zh: 冬十月壬戌，董卓殺衛尉張溫。
units.en: On renxu in the tenth month Dong Zhuo executed Zhang Wen, commandant of the guards.
units.literal: On renxu of winter, the tenth month, Dong Zhuo killed Commandant of the Guards Zhang Wen.

units.zh: 十一月，青州黃巾寇太山，太山太守應劭擊破之。
units.en: In the eleventh month Qingzhou Yellow Turbans invaded Taishan; Ying Shao, the governor, drove them off.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, the Qingzhou Yellow Turbans raided Mount Tai, and Mount Tai Governor Ying Shao attacked and defeated them.

units.zh: 黃巾轉寇勃海，公孫瓚與戰於東光，復大破之。
units.en: The Yellow Turbans swung into Bohai; Gongsun Zan crushed them again at Dongguang.
units.literal: The Yellow Turbans turned to raid Bohai; Gongsun Zan fought them at Dongguang and again greatly defeated them.

units.zh: 是歲，長沙有人死經月復活。
units.en: That year Changsha reported a man who had been dead a month and then sat up alive.
units.literal: That year, in Changsha a man died and after a month revived.

units.zh: 三年春正月丁丑，大赦天下。
units.en: On dingchou in the first month of the third year a general amnesty was granted.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month dingchou, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 袁術遣將孫堅攻劉表於襄陽，堅戰歿。
units.en: Yuan Shu ordered Sun Jian against Liu Biao at Xiangyang; Sun Jian fell in the fighting.
units.literal: Yuan Shu sent his general Sun Jian to attack Liu Biao at Xiangyang; Jian died in battle.

units.zh: 袁紹及公孫瓚戰於界橋，瓚軍大敗。
units.en: Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan met at the Jie Bridge; the army of Gongsun Zan was routed.
units.literal: Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan fought at Jie Bridge; Zan’s army was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 夏四月辛巳，誅董卓，夷三族。
units.en: On xinsi in the fourth month Dong Zhuo was put to death and his kin to the third degree wiped out.
units.literal: On xinsi of summer, the fourth month, Dong Zhuo was executed and his three clans exterminated.

units.zh: 司徒王允錄尚書事，總朝政，遣使者張种撫慰山東。
units.en: Wang Yun, minister of education, took charge of the secretariat and state affairs and sent Zhang Chong east to reassure the regional lords.
units.literal: Minister of Education Wang Yun supervised the Masters of Writing and overall court government, and sent envoy Zhang Chong to console the east of the passes.

units.zh: 青州黃巾擊殺兗州刺史劉岱於東平。
units.en: The Qingzhou Yellow Turbans slew Liu Dai, the inspector of Yan, at Dongping.
units.literal: The Qingzhou Yellow Turbans attacked and killed Inspector of Yan Liu Dai at Dongping.

units.zh: 東郡太守曹操大破黃巾於壽張，降之。
units.en: Cao Cao, governor of Dong commandery, shattered the Yellow Turbans at Shouzhang and took their surrender.
units.literal: Administrator of Dong commandery Cao Cao greatly defeated the Yellow Turbans at Shouzhang and accepted their surrender.

units.zh: 五月丁酉，大赦天下。
units.en: On dingyou in the fifth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On dingyou of the fifth month, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 丁未，征西將軍皇甫嵩為車騎將軍。
units.en: On dingwei Huangfu Song, general who guards the west, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry.
units.literal: On dingwei, General Who Guards the West Huangfu Song was made General of Chariots and Cavalry.

units.zh: 董卓部曲將李傕、郭汜、樊稠、張濟等反，攻京師。
units.en: Li Jue, Guo Si, Fan Chou, Zhang Ji, and other officers of Dong Zhuo’s old army turned on the capital.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo’s division commanders Li Jue, Guo Si, Fan Chou, Zhang Ji, and others rebelled and attacked the capital.

units.zh: 六月戊午，陷長安城，太常种拂、太僕魯旭、大鴻臚周奐、城門校尉崔烈、越騎校尉王頎並戰歿，吏民死者萬餘人。
units.en: On wuwu the rebels stormed Chang’an; Chong Fu, Lu Xu, Zhou Huan, Cui Lie, and Wang Qi died fighting, and over ten thousand soldiers and civilians perished.
units.literal: On wuwu of the sixth month, they took Chang’an city; Minister of Ceremonies Chong Fu, Grand Coachman Lu Xu, Grand Herald Zhou Huan, Commandant of the Gates Cui Lie, and Colonel of the Agile Cavalry Wang Qi all died in battle; clerks and commoners who died were more than ten thousand.

units.zh: 李傕等並自為將軍。
units.en: Li Jue and his confederates each proclaimed themselves general.
units.literal: Li Jue and the others together styled themselves generals.

units.zh: 己未，大赦天下。
units.en: On jiwei another general amnesty was issued.
units.literal: On jiwei, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 李傕殺司隸校尉黃琬，甲子，殺司徒王允，皆滅其族。
units.en: Li Jue murdered Huang Wan, the metropolitan commandant; on jiazi he killed Wang Yun, the minister of education, and exterminated both men’s families.
units.literal: Li Jue killed Metropolitan Commandant Huang Wan; on jiazi he killed Minister of Education Wang Yun, both exterminating their clans.

units.zh: 丙子，前將軍趙謙為司徒。
units.en: On bingzi Zhao Qian, the Former General, became minister of education.
units.literal: On bingzi, Zhao Qian, the Former General, was made Minister of Education.

units.zh: 秋七月庚子，太尉馬日磾為太傅，錄尚書事。
units.en: On gengzi in the seventh month Ma Midi, grand commandant, was named grand tutor with authority over the secretariat.
units.literal: On gengzi of autumn, the seventh month, Grand Commandant Ma Midi was made Grand Tutor and supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 八月，遣日磾及太僕趙岐，持節慰撫天下。
units.en: In the eighth month Ma Midi and Zhao Qi, grand coachman, were sent with imperial credentials on a goodwill tour of the provinces.
units.literal: In the eighth month, he sent Ma Midi and Grand Coachman Zhao Qi, bearing staff of office, to console and pacify all under Heaven.

units.zh: 車騎將軍皇甫嵩為太尉。
units.en: Huangfu Song, general of chariots and cavalry, was appointed grand commandant.
units.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Huangfu Song was made Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 司徒趙謙罷。
units.en: Zhao Qian was dismissed as minister of education.
units.literal: Minister of Education Zhao Qian was removed.

units.zh: 九月，李傕自為車騎將軍，郭汜後將軍，樊稠右將軍，張濟鎮東將軍。
units.en: In the ninth month Li Jue took the rank of general of chariots and cavalry, Guo Si became general of the rear, Fan Chou general of the right, and Zhang Ji general who guards the east.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Li Jue personally became General of Chariots and Cavalry, Guo Si General of the Rear, Fan Chou General of the Right, and Zhang Ji General Who Guards the East.

units.zh: 濟出屯弘農。
units.en: Zhang Ji marched out to garrison Hongnong.
units.literal: Ji went out and encamped at Hongnong.

units.zh: 甲申，司空淳于嘉為司徒，光祿大夫楊彪為司空，並錄尚書事。
units.en: On jiashen Chunyu Jia moved from the ministry of works to the ministry of education, while Yang Biao became the minister of works; both were given secretariat oversight.
units.literal: On jiashen, Minister of Works Chunyu Jia was made Minister of Education, and Grandee of Brilliant Candidacy Yang Biao was made Minister of Works, both supervising the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 冬十二月，太尉皇甫嵩免。
units.en: Huangfu Song was removed as grand commandant in the twelfth month.
units.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, Grand Commandant Huangfu Song was dismissed.

units.zh: 光祿大夫周忠為太尉，參錄尚書事。
units.en: Zhou Zhong, a grandee of brilliant candidacy, became the grand commandant with shared secretariat authority.
units.literal: Grandee of Brilliant Candidacy Zhou Zhong was made Grand Commandant and jointly supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 四年春正月甲寅朔，日有食之。
units.en: The new moon on jiayin in the first month brought a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On jiayin, new moon of spring, the first month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丁卯，大赦天下。
units.en: On dingmao a general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: On dingmao, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 三月，袁術殺楊州刺史陳溫，據淮南。
units.en: In the third month Yuan Shu murdered Chen Wen, inspector of Yang province, and seized Huainan.
units.literal: In the third month, Yuan Shu killed Inspector of Yang Chen Wen and occupied Huainan.

units.zh: 長安宣平城門外屋自壞。
units.en: Structures outside the Xuanping Gate in Chang’an fell in without apparent cause.
units.literal: The buildings outside Chang’an’s Xuanping Gate collapsed of themselves.

units.zh: 夏五月癸酉，無雲而雷。
units.en: On guiyou in the fifth month thunder pealed from a clear sky.
units.literal: On guiyou of summer, the fifth month, there was thunder though no clouds.

units.zh: 六月，扶風大風，雨雹。
units.en: The sixth month brought a violent windstorm and hail in Fufeng.
units.literal: In the sixth month, in Fufeng there was great wind; hail fell as rain.

units.zh: 華山崩裂。
units.en: Mount Hua suffered a landslide and fissures.
units.literal: Mount Hua split and collapsed.

units.zh: 太尉周忠免，太僕朱儁為太尉，錄尚書事。
units.en: Zhou Zhong stepped down as the grand commandant; Zhu Jun, the grand coachman, replaced him with secretariat duties.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Zhou Zhong was dismissed, and Grand Coachman Zhu Jun was made Grand Commandant and supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 下邳賊闕宣自稱天子。
units.en: Que Xuan, a rebel leader in Xiapi, declared himself emperor.
units.literal: The bandit Que Xuan of Xiapi styled himself Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 雨水。
units.en: Heavy rains continued.
units.literal: Rain fell.

units.zh: 遣侍御史裴茂訊詔獄，原輕繫。
units.en: Attendant censor Pei Mao was sent to review imperial jail cases and free minor offenders.
units.literal: He sent Attendant Censor Pei Mao to interrogate imperial-prison cases and release those lightly bound.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，天狗西北行。
units.en: On xinchou a bright meteor, called the heavenly dog, streaked northwest across the sky.
units.literal: On xinchou of the sixth month, the heavenly dog meteor moved northwest.

units.zh: 九月甲午，試儒生四十餘人，上第賜位郎中，次太子舍人，下第者罷之。
units.en: On jiawu over forty classicists were examined; high scorers became gentlemen consultant, the next tier heir’s householders, and failures were sent home.
units.literal: On jiawu of the ninth month, more than forty scholars were examined; the top rank was granted gentleman consultant, the next householders for the heir apparent, and the lowest rank was dismissed.

units.zh: 詔曰：『孔子歎「學之不講」，不講則所識日忘。
units.en: The edict ran: Confucius mourned that “learning is not pursued”; without pursuit, knowledge slips away daily.
units.literal: The edict said: “Confucius lamented that ‘scholarship is not cultivated’; if it is not cultivated, then what one knows is forgotten day by day.

units.zh: 今耆儒年踰六十，去離本土，營求糧資，不得專業。
units.en: Elder scholars past sixty have left home to sit the exams yet must scramble for food and cannot study as they should.
units.literal: Now venerable scholars are past sixty, have left their native soil, and in seeking grain and funds cannot devote themselves to their specialty.

units.zh: 結童入學，白首空歸，長委農野，永絕榮望，朕甚愍焉。
units.en: They began as boys and go home old men with nothing to show, cast back to the countryside and shut out from office—this fills Us with pity.
units.literal: They entered school as children and return with white heads empty-handed, long abandoned in field and wild, their hopes of honor forever cut off—We are deeply pained.

units.zh: 其依科罷者，聽為太子舍人。』
units.en: Those who fail the grading may nonetheless be appointed as householders to the heir apparent.”
units.literal: Those dismissed according to the regulations may be heard as householders for the heir apparent.”

units.zh: 冬十月，太學行禮，車駕幸永福城門，臨觀其儀，賜博士以下各有差。
units.en: In the tenth month the university held its ceremony; the emperor watched from Yongfu Gate and rewarded the faculty in graded gifts.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Imperial Academy performed the rites; the imperial carriage visited Yongfu Gate and observed the ceremony, bestowing on the erudits and below each according to degree.

units.zh: 辛丑，京師地震。
units.en: On xinchou the capital region shook with an earthquake.
units.literal: On xinchou, there was an earthquake in the capital.

units.zh: 有星孛於天市。
units.en: A comet appeared in the Celestial Market constellation.
units.literal: There was a broom star in the Celestial Market Enclosure.

units.zh: 司空楊彪免，太常趙溫為司空。
units.en: Yang Biao left the ministry of works; Zhao Wen, minister of ceremonies, succeeded him.
units.literal: Minister of Works Yang Biao was dismissed, and Minister of Ceremonies Zhao Wen was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 公孫瓚殺大司馬劉虞。
units.en: Gongsun Zan murdered Liu Yu, grand marshal.
units.literal: Gongsun Zan killed Grand Marshal Liu Yu.

units.zh: 十二月辛丑，地震。
units.en: On xinchou in the twelfth month an earthquake struck.
units.literal: On xinchou of the twelfth month, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 司空趙溫免，乙巳，衛尉張喜為司空。
units.en: Zhao Wen left the ministry of works; on yisi Zhang Xi, commandant of the guards, succeeded him.
units.literal: Minister of Works Zhao Wen was dismissed; on yisi, Commandant of the Guards Zhang Xi was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 是歲，琅邪王容薨。
units.en: That year King Rong of Langye died.
units.literal: That year, King Rong of Langye died.

units.zh: 興平元年春正月辛酉，大赦天下，改元興平。
units.en: On xinyou in the first month of the first Xingping year a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Xingping.
units.literal: In the first year of Xingping, spring, first month xinyou, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven and changed the reign title to Xingping.

units.zh: 甲子，帝加元服。
units.en: On jiazi the emperor underwent the capping ceremony and came of age.
units.literal: On jiazi, the emperor added the capping-garment.

units.zh: 二月壬午，追尊謚皇妣王氏為靈懷皇后，甲申，改葬於文昭陵。
units.en: On renwu the emperor’s mother, Lady Wang, was given the posthumous title Empress Linghuai; on jiashen her remains were moved to Wenzhao Mausoleum.
units.literal: On renwu of the second month, he posthumously honored his late mother née Wang with the title Empress Linghuai; on jiashen she was reburied at Wenzhao Mausoleum.

units.zh: 丁亥，帝耕於藉田。
units.en: On dinghai the emperor performed the spring plowing rite at the ritual field.
units.literal: On dinghai, the emperor plowed at the sacred field.

units.zh: 三月，韓遂、馬騰與郭汜、樊稠戰於長平觀，遂、騰敗績，左中郎將劉範、前益州刺史种劭戰歿。
units.en: In the third month Han Sui and Ma Teng clashed with Guo Si and Fan Chou at Changping Lodge and were beaten; Liu Fan and Chong Shao died in the fighting.
units.literal: In the third month, Han Sui and Ma Teng fought Guo Si and Fan Chou at the Changping Lodge observation tower; Sui and Teng were routed; General of the Household for the Left Liu Fan and former Inspector of Yi Chong Shao died in battle.

units.zh: 夏六月丙子，分涼州河西四郡為廱州。
units.en: On bingzi in the sixth month the four Hexi commanderies were split off from Liang as a new Yong province.
units.literal: In summer, sixth month bingzi, he divided the four commanderies west of the River in Liang province to form Yong province.

units.zh: 丁丑，地震；
units.en: On dingchou the earth shook.
units.literal: On dingchou, there was an earthquake;

units.zh: 戊寅，又震。
units.en: On wuyin another tremor struck.
units.literal: On wuyin, again there was a quake.

units.zh: 乙巳晦，日有食之，帝避正殿，寢兵，不聽事五日。
units.en: A solar eclipse on the month’s last day, yisi, led the emperor to withdraw from court, stand down the guard, and suspend audiences for five days.
units.literal: On yisi, last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse; the emperor avoided the main hall, rested weapons, and did not hear cases for five days.

units.zh: 大蝗。
units.en: Locusts swarmed in devastating numbers.
units.literal: There were great locusts.

units.zh: 秋七月壬子，太尉朱儁免。
units.en: In the seventh month Zhu Jun was removed as grand commandant.
units.literal: On renzi of autumn, the seventh month, Grand Commandant Zhu Jun was dismissed.

units.zh: 戊午，太常楊彪為太尉，錄尚書事。
units.en: On wuwu Yang Biao, the minister of ceremonies, became the grand commandant with secretariat authority.
units.literal: On wuwu, Minister of Ceremonies Yang Biao was made Grand Commandant and supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 三輔大旱，自四月至于是月。
units.en: From the fourth month through the seventh the metropolitan region baked under severe drought.
units.literal: The Three Adjuncts suffered great drought, from the fourth month until this month.

units.zh: 帝避正殿請雨，遣使者洗囚徒，原輕繫。
units.en: He quit the main hall to seek rain, had prisoners ritually cleansed, and freed minor offenders.
units.literal: The emperor avoided the main hall to pray for rain, sent envoys to bathe prisoners, and released those lightly bound.

units.zh: 是時穀一斛五十萬，豆麥一斛二十萬，人相食啖，白骨委積。
units.en: Grain reached half a million cash a hu, beans and wheat two hundred thousand; cannibalism spread and bones littered the streets.
units.literal: At this time grain was five hundred thousand cash per hu, beans and wheat two hundred thousand per hu; people ate one another; white bones piled up.

units.zh: 帝使侍御史侯汶出太倉米豆，為飢人作糜粥，經日而死者無降。
units.en: Hou Wen was told to draw grain from the imperial granary for gruel kitchens, but the daily death toll did not fall.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Attendant Censor Hou Wen to issue rice and beans from the great granary and make gruel for the starving, yet after a full day the dead did not decrease.

units.zh: 帝疑賦恤有虛，乃親於御坐前量試作糜，乃知非實，使侍中劉艾出讓有司。
units.en: Suspecting fraud in famine relief, the emperor had gruel prepared before his seat and proved the ration was short; he sent Liu Ai to rebuke the officials in charge.
units.literal: The emperor suspected the relief distribution was false; he personally before the imperial seat measured and tested making gruel, then knew it was not true, and sent Palace Attendant Liu Ai out to reprove the responsible officials.

units.zh: 於是尚書令以下皆詣省閣謝，奏收侯汶考實。
units.en: The director of the secretariat downward went to apologize and asked that Hou Wen be arrested and questioned.
units.literal: Thereupon the director of the secretariat and below all went to the secretariat gate to apologize, memorializing to seize Hou Wen and investigate the truth.

units.zh: 詔曰：『未忍致汶於理，可杖五十。』
units.en: The edict read, “I will not send Hou Wen to trial; give him fifty strokes of the rod.”.
units.literal: The edict said, “I cannot bear to subject Wen to the law; he may be caned fifty strokes.”.

units.zh: 自是之後，多得全濟。
units.en: After that, famine victims more often survived.
units.literal: From this time afterward, many obtained full relief.

units.zh: 八月，馮翊羌叛，寇屬縣，郭汜、樊稠擊破之。
units.en: In the eighth month Fengyi Qiang raiders struck outlying counties until Guo Si and Fan Chou drove them off.
units.literal: In the eighth month, the Fengyi Qiang rebelled, raiding dependent counties; Guo Si and Fan Chou attacked and defeated them.

units.zh: 九月，桑復生椹，人得以食。
units.en: In the ninth month mulberries flowered out of season, giving people something to eat.
units.literal: In the ninth month, mulberries again bore fruit, and people were able to eat.

units.zh: 司徒淳于嘉罷。
units.en: Chunyu Jia was dismissed as minister of education.
units.literal: Minister of Education Chunyu Jia was removed.

units.zh: 冬十月，長安市門自壞。
units.en: In the tenth month Chang’an’s market gates fell in on their own.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Chang’an’s market gates collapsed of themselves.

units.zh: 以衛尉趙溫為司徒，錄尚書事。
units.en: Zhao Wen, commandant of the guards, became minister of education with secretariat duties.
units.literal: Commandant of the Guards Zhao Wen was made Minister of Education and supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 十二月，分安定、扶風為新平郡。
units.en: In the twelfth month territory was carved from Anding and Fufeng to create Xinping commandery.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, he divided Anding and Fufeng to form Xinping commandery.

units.zh: 是歲，楊州刺史劉繇與袁術將孫策戰於曲阿，繇軍敗績，孫策遂據江東。
units.en: That year Inspector of Yang Liu Yao fought Yuan Shu’s general Sun Ce at Qu’e; Yao’s army was routed, and Sun Ce then occupied the lands east of the Yangzi.
units.literal: That year, Inspector of Yang Liu Yao fought Yuan Shu’s general Sun Ce at Qu’e; Yao’s army was routed, and Sun Ce thereupon occupied the lands east of the Yangzi.

units.zh: 太傅馬日磾薨於壽春。
units.en: Ma Midi, grand tutor, died at Shouchun.
units.literal: Grand Tutor Ma Midi died at Shouchun.

units.zh: 二年春正月癸丑，大赦天下。
units.en: On guichou in the first month of the second year a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month guichou, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 二月乙亥，李傕殺樊稠而與郭汜相攻。
units.en: On yihai Li Jue murdered Fan Chou and opened hostilities against the warlord Guo Si.
units.literal: On yihai of the second month, Li Jue killed Fan Chou and turned to attack Guo Si.

units.zh: 三月丙寅，李傕脅帝幸其營，焚宮室。
units.en: On bingyin Li Jue forced the emperor into his encampment and torched the palaces.
units.literal: On bingyin of the third month, Li Jue coerced the emperor to visit his camp and burned the palace buildings.

units.zh: 夏四月甲午，立貴人伏氏為皇后。
units.en: On jiawu in the fourth month Worthy Lady Fu was elevated to empress.
units.literal: On jiawu of summer, the fourth month, the Worthy Lady née Fu was established as empress.

units.zh: 丁酉，郭汜攻李傕，矢及御前。
units.en: On dingyou Guo Si’s assault on Li Jue brought missiles to the emperor’s very feet.
units.literal: On dingyou, Guo Si attacked Li Jue; arrows reached before the imperial presence.

units.zh: 是日，李傕移帝幸北塢。
units.en: That same day Li Jue hustled the court into the northern walled camp.
units.literal: That day, Li Jue moved the emperor to visit the northern stockade.

units.zh: 大旱。
units.en: A punishing drought continued.
units.literal: There was great drought.

units.zh: 五月壬午，李傕自為大司馬。
units.en: On renwu in the fifth month Li Jue took the title of grand marshal.
units.literal: On renwu of the fifth month, Li Jue personally became grand marshal.

units.zh: 六月庚午，張濟自陜來和傕、汜。
units.en: On gengwu Zhang Ji arrived from Shan to mediate between Li Jue and Guo Si.
units.literal: On gengwu of the sixth month, Zhang Ji came from Shan to reconcile Li Jue and Guo Si.

units.zh: 秋七月甲子，車駕東歸。
units.en: On jiazi in the seventh month the court began its march back east.
units.literal: On jiazi of autumn, the seventh month, the imperial carriage set out eastward to return.

units.zh: 郭汜自為車騎將軍，楊定為後將軍，楊奉為興義將軍，董承為安集將軍，並侍送乘輿。
units.en: Guo Si took rank as general of chariots and cavalry while Yang Ding, Yang Feng, and Dong Cheng received generalcies and formed the escort for the emperor’s train.
units.literal: Guo Si personally became General of Chariots and Cavalry, Yang Ding General of the Rear, Yang Feng General Who Raises Righteousness, Dong Cheng General Who Pacifies and Gathers, all attending and escorting the imperial equipage.

units.zh: 張濟為票騎將軍，還屯陜。
units.en: Zhang Ji was named general of agile cavalry and went back to garrison Shan.
units.literal: Zhang Ji was made General of Agile Cavalry and returned to encamp at Shan.

units.zh: 八月甲辰，幸新豐。
units.en: On jiachen the court reached Xinfeng.
units.literal: On jiachen of the eighth month, he visited Xinfeng.

units.zh: 冬十月戊戌，郭汜使其將伍習夜燒所幸學舍，逼脅乘輿。
units.en: On wuxu Guo Si sent Wu Xi to fire the school compound where the emperor was staying, pressing the court to move on.
units.literal: On wuxu of winter, the tenth month, Guo Si had his general Wu Xi burn by night the school lodgings where the emperor had lodged, coercing the imperial equipage.

units.zh: 楊定、楊奉與郭汜戰，破之。
units.en: Yang Ding and Yang Feng attacked Guo Si and broke his force.
units.literal: Yang Ding and Yang Feng fought Guo Si and defeated him.

units.zh: 壬寅，幸華陰，露次道南。
units.en: On renyin the party halted south of the road at Huayin.
units.literal: On renyin, he visited Huayin and bivouacked south of the road.

units.zh: 是夜，有赤氣貫紫宮。
units.en: That night crimson light shot through the Purple Palace asterism.
units.literal: That night, red vapors pierced the Purple Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 張濟復反，與李傕、郭汜合。
units.en: Zhang Ji turned coat again and allied with Li Jue and Guo Si.
units.literal: Zhang Ji rebelled again and joined Li Jue and Guo Si.

units.zh: 十一月庚午，李傕、郭汜等追乘輿，戰於東澗，王師敗績，殺光祿勳鄧泉、衛尉士孫瑞、廷尉宣播、大長秋苗祀、步兵校尉魏桀、侍中朱展、射聲校尉沮儁。
units.en: On gengwu Li Jue and Guo Si overtook the imperial column at Eastern Stream, shattered the escort, and slew Deng Quan, Shisun Rui, Xuan Bo, Miao Si, Wei Jie, Zhu Zhan, and Ju Jun.
units.literal: On gengwu of the eleventh month, Li Jue, Guo Si, and others pursued the imperial equipage, fought at Eastern Stream, the royal army was routed, and they killed Superintendent of the Household for Imperial Proceedings Deng Quan, Commandant of the Guards Shisun Rui, Commandant of Justice Xuan Bo, Grand Prolonger of Autumn Miao Si, Colonel of the Foot Soldiers Wei Jie, Palace Attendant Zhu Zhan, and Colonel of the Archers Who Let Their Sound Ring Ju Jun.

units.zh: 壬申，幸曹陽，露次田中。
units.en: On renshen the court took refuge in the open fields at Caoyang.
units.literal: On renshen, he visited Caoyang and bivouacked in the fields.

units.zh: 楊奉、董承引白波帥胡才、李樂、韓暹及匈奴左賢王去卑，率師奉迎，與李傕等戰，破之。
units.en: Yang Feng and Dong Cheng rallied Hu Cai, Li Yue, Han Xian, and the Xiongnu left worthy king Qubei, relieved the emperor, and turned back Li Jue’s pursuit.
units.literal: Yang Feng and Dong Cheng brought the White Wave chiefs Hu Cai, Li Yue, Han Xian, and the Southern Xiongnu Worthy King of the Left Qubei, led troops to welcome and support, and fought Li Jue and others, defeating them.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰，車駕乃進。
units.en: On gengchen the column was able to move forward again.
units.literal: On gengchen of the twelfth month, the imperial carriage then advanced.

units.zh: 李傕等復來追戰，王師大敗，殺略宮人，少府田芬、大司農張義等皆戰歿。
units.en: Li Jue struck again, routing the escort, slaughtering and seizing ladies of the palace; Tian Fen, Zhang Yi, and others fell in the melee.
units.literal: Li Jue and others again came in pursuit and battle; the royal army was greatly defeated; they killed and carried off palace women; Junior Prefect Tian Fen, Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhang Yi, and others all died in battle.

units.zh: 進幸陜，夜度河。
units.en: The party pressed on to Shan and forded the river under cover of darkness.
units.literal: He advanced to visit Shan and crossed the river by night.

units.zh: 乙亥，幸安邑。
units.en: On yihai the emperor reached Anyi.
units.literal: On yihai, he visited Anyi.

units.zh: 建安元年春正月癸酉，郊祀上帝於安邑，大赦天下，改元建安。
units.en: On guiyou in the first month of the first Jian’an year the court sacrificed to Heaven at Anyi, proclaimed a general amnesty, and adopted the era name Jian’an.
units.literal: In the first year of Jian’an, spring, first month guiyou, he sacrificed to High God at the suburban altar in Anyi, issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven, and changed the reign title to Jian’an.

units.zh: 二月，韓暹攻衛將軍董承。
units.en: In the second month Han Xian attacked Dong Cheng, general of the guards.
units.literal: In the second month, Han Xian attacked General of the Guards Dong Cheng.

units.zh: 夏六月乙未，幸聞喜。
units.en: In the sixth month, on yiwei, the emperor visited Wenxi.
units.literal: In summer, on yiwei in the sixth month, he visited Wenxi.

units.zh: 秋七月甲子，車駕至洛陽，幸故中常侍趙忠宅。
units.en: On jiazi in the seventh month the court entered Luoyang and lodged in the old mansion of Zhao Zhong.
units.literal: On jiazi of autumn, the seventh month, the imperial carriage reached Luoyang and visited the former residence of Household Regular Attendant Zhao Zhong.

units.zh: 丁丑，郊祀上帝，大赦天下。
units.en: On dingchou he offered the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: On dingchou, he sacrificed at the suburban altar to High God and issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 己卯，謁太廟。
units.en: On jimao he paid his respects at the dynastic temple.
units.literal: On jimao, he visited the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 八月辛丑，幸南宮楊安殿。
units.en: On xinchou the court took up the Yang’an Hall in the Southern Palace.
units.literal: On xinchou of the eighth month, he visited the Yang’an Hall of the Southern Palace.

units.zh: 癸卯，安國將軍張楊為大司馬，韓暹為大將軍，楊奉為車騎將軍。
units.en: On guimao Zhang Yang became the grand marshal, Han Xian the general-in-chief, and Yang Feng the general of chariots and cavalry.
units.literal: On guimao, General Who Pacifies the State Zhang Yang was made grand marshal, Han Xian General-in-Chief, and Yang Feng General of Chariots and Cavalry.

units.zh: 是時，宮室燒盡，百官披荊棘，依牆壁間。
units.en: The palaces were ash; ministers picked their way through thorns and huddled under ruined walls.
units.literal: At this time the palace halls were burned away; the hundred officials pushed through brambles and leaned between broken walls.

units.zh: 州郡各擁彊兵，而委輸不至，群僚飢乏，尚書郎以下自出采稆，或飢死牆壁間，或為兵士所殺。
units.en: Regional warlords kept their armies home and sent no supplies; clerks starved; junior secretariat men foraged for wild grain and died in the ruins or at soldiers’ hands.
units.literal: The provinces and commanderies each held strong troops, yet tribute grain did not arrive; the host of officials hungered; secretariat gentlemen and below went out themselves to gather wild beans, some starving to death between the walls, some killed by soldiers.

units.zh: 辛亥，鎮東將軍曹操自領司隸校尉，錄尚書事。
units.en: On xinhai Cao Cao, general who guards the east, added metropolitan commandant and control of the secretariat.
units.literal: On xinhai, General Who Guards the East Cao Cao personally took Metropolitan Commandant and supervised the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 曹操殺侍中臺崇、尚書馮碩等。
units.en: Cao Cao executed Tai Chong, Feng Shuo, and other courtiers.
units.literal: Cao Cao killed Palace Attendant Tai Chong, Director of the Secretariat Feng Shuo, and others.

units.zh: 封衛將軍董承為輔國將軍，伏完等十三人為列侯，贈沮儁為弘農太守。
units.en: Dong Cheng was promoted to general who aids the state, thirteen men including Fu Wan received marquisates, and Ju Jun was honored posthumously as governor of Hongnong.
units.literal: He enfeoffed General of the Guards Dong Cheng as General Who Aids the State, thirteen men including Fu Wan as full marquises, and posthumously invested Ju Jun as governor of Hongnong.

units.zh: 庚申，遷都許。
units.en: On gengshen the seat of government shifted to Xu.
units.literal: On gengshen, he moved the capital to Xu.

units.zh: 己巳，幸曹操營。
units.en: On jisi the emperor lodged in Cao Cao’s encampment.
units.literal: On jisi, he visited Cao Cao’s camp.

units.zh: 九月，太尉楊彪、司空張喜罷。
units.en: In the ninth month Yang Biao and Zhang Xi left the posts of grand commandant and minister of works.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Grand Commandant Yang Biao and Minister of Works Zhang Xi were removed.

units.zh: 冬十一月丙戌，曹操自為司空，行車騎將軍事，百官總己以聽。
units.en: On bingxu Cao Cao took the ministry of works and exercised the powers of general of chariots and cavalry; the bureaucracy answered only to him.
units.literal: On bingxu of winter, the eleventh month, Cao Cao personally became Minister of Works and acted the business of General of Chariots and Cavalry; the hundred officials tied up their seals to obey him.

units.zh: 二年春，袁術自稱天子。
units.en: In the spring of the second year Yuan Shu declared himself emperor.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, Yuan Shu styled himself Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 三月，袁紹自為大將軍。
units.en: In the third month Yuan Shao assumed the title of general-in-chief.
units.literal: In the third month, Yuan Shao personally became General-in-Chief.

units.zh: 夏五月，蝗。
units.en: Locusts scourged the land in the fifth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, there were locusts.

units.zh: 秋九月，漢水溢。
units.en: The Han River burst its banks in the ninth month.
units.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, the Han River overflowed.

units.zh: 是歲飢，江淮閒民相食。
units.en: Famine drove the people along the Yangzi and Huai to cannibalism.
units.literal: That year there was famine; between the Yangzi and Huai the people ate one another.

units.zh: 袁術殺陳王寵。
units.en: Yuan Shu murdered Liu Chong, prince of Chen.
units.literal: Yuan Shu killed Prince Chong of Chen.

units.zh: 孫策遣使奉貢。
units.en: Sun Ce dispatched envoys with tribute to the court.
units.literal: Sun Ce sent envoys to present tribute.

units.zh: 三年夏四月，遣謁者裴茂率中郎將段煨討李傕，夷三族。
units.en: In the fourth month of the third year Pei Mao and Duan Wei were sent to destroy Li Jue and extirpate his kin to the third degree.
units.literal: In the third year, summer, fourth month, he sent Herald Pei Mao leading General of the Household Duan Wei to campaign against Li Jue and exterminate his three clans.

units.zh: 呂布叛。
units.en: Lu Bu rose in rebellion.
units.literal: Lu Bu rebelled.

units.zh: 冬十一月，盜殺大司馬張楊。
units.en: In the eleventh month assassins slew Zhang Yang, grand marshal.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, bandits killed Grand Marshal Zhang Yang.

units.zh: 十二月癸酉，曹操擊呂布於徐州，斬之。
units.en: On guiyou in the twelfth month Cao Cao defeated Lu Bu in Xu province and executed him.
units.literal: On guiyou of the twelfth month, Cao Cao attacked Lu Bu in Xu province and beheaded him.

units.zh: 四年春三月，袁紹攻公孫瓚於易京，獲之。
units.en: In the third month of the fourth year Yuan Shao took Yijing and captured Gongsun Zan.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, third month, Yuan Shao attacked Gongsun Zan at Yijing and captured him.

units.zh: 衛將軍董承為車騎將軍。
units.en: Dong Cheng, general of the guards, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry.
units.literal: General of the Guards Dong Cheng was made General of Chariots and Cavalry.

units.zh: 夏六月，袁術死。
units.en: Yuan Shu died in the sixth month.
units.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Yuan Shu died.

units.zh: 是歲，初置尚書左右僕射。
units.en: That year the posts of left and right vice director of the secretariat were first created.
units.literal: That year, for the first time he established left and right vice directors of the secretariat.

units.zh: 武陵女子死十四日復活。
units.en: A woman in Wuling who had been dead fourteen days reportedly returned to life.
units.literal: A woman of Wuling died fourteen days and revived.

units.zh: 五年春正月，車騎將軍董承、偏將軍王服、越騎校尉种輯受密詔誅曹操，事洩。
units.en: In the first month of the fifth year Dong Cheng, Wang Fu, and Zhong Ji received a secret order to kill Cao Cao, but the plot leaked.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, General of Chariots and Cavalry Dong Cheng, General of the Rear Wang Fu, and Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhong Ji received a secret edict to execute Cao Cao; the plot was exposed.

units.zh: 壬午，曹操殺董承等，夷三族。
units.en: On renwu Cao Cao executed Dong Cheng and his co-conspirators and wiped out their kin to the third degree.
units.literal: On renwu, Cao Cao killed Dong Cheng and the others and exterminated their three clans.

units.zh: 秋七月，立皇子馮為南陽王。
units.en: In the seventh month the emperor enfeoffed Liu Feng as king of Nanyang.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the imperial son Feng was established as king of Nanyang.

units.zh: 壬午，南陽王馮薨。
units.en: On renwu King Feng of Nanyang died.
units.literal: On renwu, King Feng of Nanyang died.

units.zh: 九月庚午朔，日有食之。
units.en: The new moon on gengwu in the ninth month was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the new moon gengwu of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 詔三公舉至孝二人，九卿、校尉、郡國守相各一人。
units.en: An edict called on the three excellencies to nominate two men of supreme filial piety each, and on every nine-minister, colonel, and commandery or kingdom chief each to nominate one.
units.literal: He ordered the three excellencies each to recommend two men of supreme filial piety, and the nine ministers, colonels, and governors and administrators of commanderies and kingdoms each one man.

units.zh: 皆上封事，靡有所諱。
units.en: All submitted sealed memorials with nothing held back.
units.literal: All submitted sealed memorials without withholding anything.

units.zh: 曹操與袁紹戰於官度，紹敗走。
units.en: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu and drove him into flight.
units.literal: Cao Cao fought Yuan Shao at Guandu; Shao was defeated and fled.

units.zh: 冬十月辛亥，有星孛于大梁。
units.en: On xinhai in the tenth month a comet appeared in the Daliang asterism.
units.literal: On xinhai of winter, the tenth month, there was a broom star in Daliang.

units.zh: 東海王祗薨。
units.en: King Zhi of Donghai died.
units.literal: King Zhi of Donghai died.

units.zh: 是歲，孫策死，弟權襲其餘業。
units.en: That year Sun Ce died and his brother Sun Quan took over his domain.
units.literal: That year, Sun Ce died; his younger brother Quan inherited his remaining enterprise.

units.zh: 六年春二月丁卯朔，日有食之。
units.en: The new moon on dingmao in the second month of the sixth year was eclipsed.
units.literal: On dingmao, new moon of spring, the second month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 七年夏五月庚戌，袁紹薨。
units.en: On gengxu in the fifth month of the seventh year Yuan Shao died.
units.literal: On gengxu of summer, the fifth month of the seventh year, Yuan Shao died.

units.zh: 于窴國獻馴象。
units.en: The kingdom of Khotan sent trained elephants as tribute.
units.literal: The state of Khotan presented tame elephants.

units.zh: 是歲，越巂男子化為女子。
units.en: That year a man in Yuexi was said to have transformed into a woman.
units.literal: That year, a man of Yuexi commandery changed into a woman.

units.zh: 八年冬十月己巳，公卿初迎冬於北郊，總章始復備八佾舞。
units.en: On jisi in the tenth month the court held the winter welcoming rite at the northern suburb and restored the eight-row dance at the Hall of Grand Unity.
units.literal: On jisi of winter, the tenth month of the eighth year, the excellencies and ministers for the first time welcomed winter at the northern suburb, and the Hall of Grand Unity again fully prepared the eight-row dance.

units.zh: 初置司直官，督中都官。
units.en: The new post of director upright was created to oversee metropolitan officials.
units.literal: For the first time he established the office of director upright, to supervise capital officials.

units.zh: 九年秋八月戊寅，曹操大破袁尚，平冀州，自領冀州牧。
units.en: On wuyin in the eighth month Cao Cao crushed Yuan Shang, subdued Ji province, and added the title shepherd of Ji.
units.literal: On wuyin of autumn, the eighth month of the ninth year, Cao Cao greatly defeated Yuan Shang, pacified Ji province, and personally took Shepherd of Ji.

units.zh: 冬十月，有星孛於東井。
units.en: A comet appeared in the Eastern Well constellation in the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, there was a broom star in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 十二月，賜三公已下金、帛，各有差。
units.en: In the twelfth month gold and silk were distributed down the official ladder by rank.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, he bestowed gold and silk on the three excellencies and below, each according to degree.

units.zh: 自是三年一賜，以為常制。
units.en: Henceforth such gifts were to be made every three years by rule.
units.literal: From this time every three years there was one such grant, taken as standing regulation.

units.zh: 十年春正月，曹操破袁譚於青州，斬之。
units.en: In the first month of the tenth year Cao Cao destroyed Yuan Tan in Qing province and took his head.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Tan in Qing province and beheaded him.

units.zh: 夏四月，黑山賊張燕率眾降。
units.en: In the fourth month Zhang Yan of the Hei Mountain band surrendered with his followers.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the Hei Mountain bandit Zhang Yan led his host to surrender.

units.zh: 秋九月，賜百官尤貧者金、帛，各有差。
units.en: In the ninth month the neediest officials received graded gifts of gold and silk.
units.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, he bestowed gold and silk on the hundred officials who were especially poor, each according to degree.

units.zh: 十一年春正月，有星孛於北斗。
units.en: A comet blazed in the Northern Dipper in the first month of the eleventh year.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, first month, there was a broom star in the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 三月，曹操破高幹於幷州，獲之。
units.en: In the third month Cao Cao took Gao Gan in Bing province alive.
units.literal: In the third month, Cao Cao defeated Gao Gan in Bing province and captured him.

units.zh: 秋七月，武威太守張猛殺雍州刺史邯鄲商。
units.en: In the seventh month Zhang Meng, governor of Wuwei, murdered Handan Shang, inspector of Yong.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Wuwei Governor Zhang Meng killed Inspector of Yong Handan Shang.

units.zh: 是歲，立故琅邪王容子熙為琅邪王。
units.en: That year Liu Xi, son of the late Prince Rong of Langye, was installed as king of Langye.
units.literal: That year, he established the former king of Langye Rong’s son Xi as king of Langye.

units.zh: 齊、北海、阜陵、下邳、常山、甘陵、濟北、平原八國皆除。
units.en: The eight vassal kingdoms of Qi, Beihai, Fuling, Xiapi, Changshan, Ganling, Jibei, and Pingyuan were abolished.
units.literal: The eight kingdoms of Qi, Beihai, Fuling, Xiapi, Changshan, Ganling, Jibei, and Pingyuan were all abolished.

units.zh: 十二年秋八月，曹操大破烏桓於柳城，斬其蹋頓。
units.en: In the eighth month of the twelfth year Cao Cao shattered the Wuhuan at Liucheng and killed their chieftain Tadun.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, autumn, eighth month, Cao Cao greatly defeated the Wuhuan at Liucheng and beheaded their Tadun.

units.zh: 冬十月辛卯，有星孛於鶉尾。
units.en: On xinmao in the tenth month a comet appeared in the Quail’s Tail.
units.literal: On xinmao of winter, the tenth month, there was a broom star in the Quail’s Tail asterism.

units.zh: 乙巳，黃巾賊殺濟南王赟。
units.en: On yisi Yellow Turbans murdered Liu Yun, prince of Jinan.
units.literal: On yisi, Yellow Turban bandits killed Prince Yun of Jinan.

units.zh: 十一月，遼東太守公孫康殺袁尚、袁熙。
units.en: In the eleventh month Gongsun Kang, governor of Liaodong, executed Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Liaodong Governor Gongsun Kang killed Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi.

units.zh: 十三年春正月，司徒趙溫免。
units.en: In the first month of the thirteenth year Zhao Wen was removed as minister of education.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, Minister of Education Zhao Wen was dismissed.

units.zh: 夏六月，罷三公官，置丞相、御史大夫。
units.en: In the sixth month the three excellencies were abolished and replaced by a chancellor and an imperial counselor.
units.literal: In summer, the sixth month, he abolished the three excellencies’ offices and established chancellor and imperial counselor.

units.zh: 癸巳，曹操自為丞相。
units.en: On guisi Cao Cao took the title of chancellor.
units.literal: On guisi, Cao Cao personally became chancellor.

units.zh: 秋七月，曹操南征劉表。
units.en: In the seventh month Cao Cao marched south against Liu Biao.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Cao Cao campaigned south against Liu Biao.

units.zh: 八月丁未，光祿勳郗慮為御史大夫。
units.en: On dingwei Xi Lu, superintendent of the household for imperial proceedings, became imperial counselor.
units.literal: On dingwei of the eighth month, Superintendent of the Household for Imperial Proceedings Xi Lu was made imperial counselor.

units.zh: 壬子，曹操殺太中大夫孔融，夷其族。
units.en: On renzi Cao Cao executed Kong Rong, the grand counselor, and wiped out his family.
units.literal: On renzi, Cao Cao killed Grand Counselor Kong Rong and exterminated his clan.

units.zh: 是月，劉表卒，少子琮立，琮以荊州降操。
units.en: That same month Liu Biao died; his younger son Liu Cong succeeded and handed the Jing province to Cao Cao.
units.literal: That month, Liu Biao died; his younger son Cong succeeded, and Cong surrendered Jing province to Cao.

units.zh: 冬十月癸未朔，日有食之。
units.en: The tenth month opened on guiwei with a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On guiwei, new moon of winter, the tenth month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 曹操以舟師伐孫權，權將周瑜敗之於烏林、赤壁。
units.en: Cao Cao attacked Sun Quan by water; Zhou Yu broke the northern fleet at Wulin and Chibi.
units.literal: Cao Cao with a fleet campaigned against Sun Quan; Quan’s general Zhou Yu defeated him at Wulin and Chibi.

units.zh: 十四年冬十月，荊州地震。
units.en: In the tenth month of the fourteenth year Jing province was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, winter, tenth month, there was an earthquake in Jing province.

units.zh: 十五年春二月乙巳朔，日有食之。
units.en: The second month of the fifteenth year opened on yisi with a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On yisi, new moon of spring, the second month of the fifteenth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十六年秋九月庚戌，曹操與韓遂、馬超戰於渭南，遂等大敗，關西平。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, in autumn, on gengxu in the ninth month, Cao Cao fought Han Sui and Ma Chao at Weinan; Sui and his allies were badly defeated, and the lands west of the passes were pacified.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, in autumn, in the ninth month, on gengxu, Cao Cao fought Han Sui and Ma Chao at Weinan; Sui and the others were greatly defeated, and the region west of the passes was pacified.

units.zh: 是歲，趙王赦薨。
units.en: That year, She, King of Zhao, died.
units.literal: That year, She, King of Zhao, died.

units.zh: 十七年夏五月癸未，誅衛尉馬騰，夷三族。
units.en: On guiwei in the fifth month of the seventeenth year Ma Teng, commandant of the guards, was executed with extirpation to the third degree of kinship.
units.literal: On guiwei of summer, the fifth month of the seventeenth year, Commandant of the Guards Ma Teng was executed and his three clans exterminated.

units.zh: 六月庚寅晦，日有食之。
units.en: A solar eclipse fell on the last day of the sixth month, gengyin.
units.literal: On gengyin, last day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 秋七月，洧水、潁水溢。
units.en: The Wei and Ying rivers burst their banks in the seventh month.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Wei and Ying rivers overflowed.

units.zh: 螟。
units.en: Borer insects damaged the crops.
units.literal: There were crop borers.

units.zh: 八月，馬超破涼州，殺刺史韋康。
units.en: In the eighth month Ma Chao overran Liang and slew Wei Kang, the inspector.
units.literal: In the eighth month, Ma Chao broke Liang province and killed Inspector Wei Kang.

units.zh: 九月庚戌，立皇子熙為濟陰王，懿為山陽王，邈為濟北王，敦為東海王。
units.en: On gengxu the emperor enfeoffed Liu Xi as king of Jiyin, Liu Yi as king of Shanyang, Liu Miao as king of Jibei, and Liu Dun as king of Donghai.
units.literal: On gengxu of the ninth month, the imperial sons Xi, Yi, Miao, and Dun were established as kings of Jiyin, Shanyang, Jibei, and Donghai respectively.

units.zh: 冬十二月，星孛於五諸侯。
units.en: In the twelfth month a comet shone in the Five Feudal Lords constellation.
units.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, a broom star appeared in the Five Feudal Lords asterism.

units.zh: 十八年春正月庚寅，復《禹貢》九州。
units.en: On gengyin in the first month of the eighteenth year the administrative map was redrawn to match the nine provinces of the 《Tribute of Yu》.
units.literal: On gengyin of spring, the first month of the eighteenth year, he restored the nine provinces of the 《Tribute of Yu》.

units.zh: 十九年夏四月，旱。
units.en: The fourth month of the nineteenth year brought drought.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, summer, fourth month, there was drought.

units.zh: 五月，雨水。
units.en: Heavy rain fell in the fifth month.
units.literal: In the fifth month, rain fell.

units.zh: 劉備破劉璋，據益州。
units.en: Liu Bei overthrew Liu Zhang and seized Yi province.
units.literal: Liu Bei defeated Liu Zhang and occupied Yi province.

units.zh: 冬十月，曹操遣將夏侯淵討宋建於枹罕，獲之。
units.en: In the tenth month Cao Cao dispatched Xiahou Yuan against Song Jian at Fuhan and took him captive.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Cao Cao sent his general Xiahou Yuan to campaign against Song Jian at Fuhan and captured him.

units.zh: 十一月丁卯，曹操殺皇后伏氏，滅其族及二皇子。
units.en: On dingmao in the eleventh month Cao Cao executed Empress Fu, her entire clan, and her two young sons.
units.literal: On dingmao of the eleventh month, Cao Cao killed Empress née Fu and extinguished her clan and the two imperial sons.

units.zh: 二十年春正月甲子，立貴人曹氏為皇后。
units.en: On jiazi in the first month of the twentieth year Worthy Lady Cao was elevated to empress.
units.literal: On jiazi of spring, the first month of the twentieth year, the Worthy Lady née Cao was established as empress.

units.zh: 賜天下男子爵，人一級，孝悌、力田二級。
units.en: Every man in the realm received one step in rank; model sons and model farmers received two.
units.literal: He bestowed noble ranks on the men of the empire, one grade each; filial and fraternal conduct and exert-fielders two grades.

units.zh: 賜諸王侯公卿以下穀，各有差。
units.en: Grain was distributed to princes and officials down the ladder in graded amounts.
units.literal: He bestowed grain on the kings, marquises, excellencies, and ministers of state and below, each according to degree.

units.zh: 秋七月，曹操破漢中，張魯降。
units.en: In the seventh month Cao Cao conquered Hanzhong and Zhang Lu submitted.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Cao Cao broke Hanzhong and Zhang Lu surrendered.

units.zh: 二十一年夏四月甲午，曹操自進號魏王。
units.en: On jiawu in the fourth month of the twenty-first year Cao Cao took the title king of Wei.
units.literal: On jiawu of summer, the fourth month of the twenty-first year, Cao Cao personally advanced his title to king of Wei.

units.zh: 五月己亥朔，日有食之。
units.en: The fifth month opened on jihai with a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On jihai, new moon of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 秋七月，匈奴南單于來朝。
units.en: In the seventh month the Southern Xiongnu Shanyu paid a formal visit to the court.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Southern Shanyu of the Xiongnu came to court.

units.zh: 是歲，曹操殺琅邪王熙，國除。
units.en: That year Cao Cao executed Liu Xi, king of Langye, and abolished the kingdom.
units.literal: That year, Cao Cao killed Prince Xi of Langye and abolished the kingdom.

units.zh: 坐謀欲渡江，被誅。
units.en: He was executed for plotting to cross the Yangzi.
units.literal: He was executed for plotting to cross the Yangzi.

units.zh: 二十二年夏六月，丞相軍師華歆為御史大夫。
units.en: In the sixth month of the twenty-second year Hua Xin, the chancellor’s army counselor, became imperial counselor.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, summer, sixth month, Chancellor’s Army Counselor Hua Xin was made imperial counselor.

units.zh: 冬，有星孛於東北。
units.en: A comet blazed in the northeastern sky that winter.
units.literal: In winter, there was a broom star in the northeast.

units.zh: 是歲大疫。
units.en: A terrible epidemic swept the land that year.
units.literal: That year there was a great plague.

units.zh: 二十三年春正月甲子，少府耿紀、丞相司直韋晃起兵誅曹操，不克，夷三族。
units.en: On jiazi Geng Ji and Wei Huang attempted a coup against Cao Cao and failed; both men’s kin to the third degree were slaughtered.
units.literal: On jiazi of spring, the first month of the twenty-third year, Junior Prefect Geng Ji and Chancellor’s Director Upright Wei Huang raised troops to execute Cao Cao; they did not overcome him; their three clans were exterminated.

units.zh: 三月，有星孛於東方。
units.en: A comet appeared in the eastern sky in the third month.
units.literal: In the third month, there was a broom star in the east.

units.zh: 二十四年春二月壬子晦，日有食之。
units.en: The second month closed on renzi with a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On renzi, last day of spring, the second month of the twenty-fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 夏五月，劉備取漢中。
units.en: Liu Bei seized Hanzhong in the fifth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Liu Bei took Hanzhong.

units.zh: 秋七月庚子，劉備自稱漢中王。
units.en: On gengzi in the seventh month Liu Bei proclaimed himself king of Hanzhong.
units.literal: On gengzi of autumn, the seventh month, Liu Bei styled himself king of Hanzhong.

units.zh: 八月，漢水溢。
units.en: The Han River flooded in the eighth month.
units.literal: In the eighth month, the Han River overflowed.

units.zh: 冬十一月，孫權取荊州。
units.en: In the eleventh month Sun Quan conquered Jing province.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Sun Quan took Jing province.

units.zh: 二十五年春正月庚子，魏王曹操薨。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year, in spring, on gengzi in the first month, Cao Cao, King of Wei, died.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, in spring, in the first month, on gengzi, Cao Cao, King of Wei, died.

units.zh: 子丕襲位。
units.en: His son Pi succeeded to his position.
units.literal: His son Pi succeeded to his position.

units.zh: 二月丁未朔，日有食之。
units.en: In the second month, on dingwei, the first day, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the second month, on dingwei, the first day, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三月，改元延康。
units.en: In the third month, the reign title was changed to Yankang.
units.literal: In the third month, the reign title was changed to Yankang.

units.zh: 冬十月乙卯，皇帝遜位，魏王丕稱天子。
units.en: On yimao in the tenth month the emperor abdicated and Cao Pi, king of Wei, became emperor.
units.literal: On yimao of winter, the tenth month, the emperor yielded the throne, and the king of Wei, Pi, assumed the title Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 奉帝為山陽公，邑一萬戶，位在諸侯王上，奏事不稱臣，受詔不拜，以天子車服郊祀天地，宗廟、祖、臘皆如漢制，都山陽之濁鹿城。
units.en: The former emperor was enfeoffed as duke of Shanyang with ten thousand households, precedence over other princes, privilege to address the throne without calling himself a subject, to receive edicts without bowing, to worship Heaven and Earth with imperial regalia, and to keep Han ritual at his court in Zhuolu.
units.literal: He honored the emperor as duke of Shanyang, with a fief of ten thousand households, rank above the kings of the feudal lords, memorializing affairs without styling himself subject, receiving edicts without bowing, using the Son of Heaven’s carriages and robes to sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the suburban altars, with ancestral temple, offering, and year-end rites all as under Han institutions, capital at Zhuolu city in Shanyang.

units.zh: 四皇子封王者，皆降為列侯。
units.en: The four imperial sons who held kingships were demoted to marquises.
units.literal: The four imperial sons who had been enfeoffed as kings were all reduced to full marquises.

units.zh: 明年，劉備稱帝於蜀，孫權亦自王於吳，於是天下遂三分矣。
units.en: The following year Liu Bei took the imperial title in Shu and Sun Quan declared himself king in Wu, and the realm split three ways.
units.literal: The next year, Liu Bei declared himself emperor in Shu, and Sun Quan likewise declared himself king in Wu; thereupon all under Heaven was split in three.

units.zh: 魏青龍二年三月庚寅，山陽公薨。
units.en: On gengyin in the third month of Wei’s second Qinglong year the duke of Shanyang died.
units.literal: On gengyin of the third month in the second year of Qinglong of Wei, the duke of Shanyang died.

units.zh: 自遜位至薨，十有四年，年五十四，謚孝獻皇帝。
units.en: Fourteen years passed from his abdication to his death at the age of fifty-four; he received the posthumous title Emperor Xian.
units.literal: From yielding the throne until his death was fourteen years; he was fifty-four; his posthumous title was Emperor Xiaoxian.

units.zh: 八月壬申，以漢天子禮儀葬於禪陵，置園邑令丞。
units.en: On renshen in the eighth month he was interred at Shan Mausoleum with full Han imperial honors and officials to tend the tomb.
units.literal: On renshen of the eighth month, he was buried at Shan Mausoleum with the rites of a Han Son of Heaven, establishing park and fief magistrate and assistant.

units.zh: 論曰：傳稱鼎之為器，雖小而重，故神之所寶，不可奪移。
units.en: The historian comments: the classics compare the throne to a bronze tripod—small yet weighty, a thing the spirits protect and none may seize by force.
units.literal: The discussion says: The tradition states that as a vessel the tripod, though small, is heavy; therefore it is what the spirits treasure and cannot be wrested away.

units.zh: 至令負而趨者，此亦窮運之歸乎！
units.en: Yet here was a man who bore that burden on his back and hurried onward—was this not fate run to its bitter end!
units.literal: As for him who to this day bears it on his back yet hastens—is this not likewise the end of exhausted fate!

units.zh: 天厭漢德久矣，山陽其何誅焉！
units.en: Heaven had turned against Han’s mandate long before; the duke of Shanyang hardly deserved reproach!
units.literal: Heaven has long wearied of Han virtue—what blame attaches to the duke of Shanyang!

units.zh: 贊曰：獻生不辰，身播國屯。
units.en: The summation reads: Emperor Xian was born under an ill star, his person tossed from throne to exile while the dynasty stumbled.
units.literal: The encomium says: Xian was born untimely; his person was cast about while the state met hardship.

units.zh: 終我四百，永作虞賓。
units.en: Thus ended the Han’s four centuries, its last sovereign standing as a guest king like the heirs of Shun before the Xia.
units.literal: He ended our four hundred years, forever to be a guest of Shun.
